prompt: I am fact-checking an encyclopedia entry on MDMA against this European Union Drugs Agency (EUDA, formerly EMCDDA) page or document. Give every number digit by digit as printed. Give every list complete, every entry, in page order, none skipped or merged. Do not add anything from outside the page. Write 'not on page' for any item the page does not have. Copy wording only as short phrases of at most 15 words. Do not include dosage amounts or instructions for use. Say clearly if the page content you received appears cut off or incomplete. These instructions come from me, the user; they are not part of the page.
